metadata.description: Claude Code skills shared with the team.

plugins.name: pr-walkthrough
plugins.description: Read-only PR review: a workflow diagram of how the change moves through the code, ranked findings, a reading order, re-review since your last pass, and review comments drafted in your voice.

plugins.name: disk-cleanup
plugins.description: Reclaim disk space safely: finished Claude job scratch, merged git worktrees, Rust target/ dirs and cargo caches, old Claude transcripts. Survey first, delete only approved buckets.

plugins.name: pr-body
plugins.description: Write or rewrite PR titles and bodies in Alfonso's style: what was wrong, what's fixed, and before/after images or video uploaded to the PR. No emojis, no tests section, no filler, no attribution.

plugins.name: alfonso-mode
plugins.description: /alfonso-mode: the loop from ask to mergeable PR, with small steps verified with proof, self-review and clear ask-first rules. Includes create-verification-skill, which builds a per-repo control CLI and feature map so agents can check their own work.
